notes.title: Version v1.0 available
notes.notes: As the release date is approaching quickly, the release version of Una ad Astra is now available. If you have beta access, simply opt out of any beta (Una ad Astra -> Properties -> Betas -> None) and Steam will update your game to v1.0. While there will be no more content updates, I will try my best to make the game as bug free as possible for the release, so let me know of any issues you might encounter still.
